name: ES Opening Location — pHOD/pLOD/pClose & Overnight Level Touch Probabilities
description: Classifies each ES RTH session open as above, within, or below the prior RTH range, then measures touch probabilities for pHOD, pLOD, and pClose conditioned on opening classification. Also computes overnight high (ONH) and overnight low (ONL) from the ETH session (16:00–09:30 ET), classifies the RTH open relative to the overnight midpoint ((ONH+ONL)/2) with ±2 pt tolerance, and shows ONH/ONL touch probabilities during RTH for each classification. Six summary tables total. Uses LiquidityBased rollover with NoAdjustment on 1-minute ES futures data. Filters out holidays and Black Friday sessions.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES OPENING LOCATION — pHOD / pLOD / pClose TOUCH PROBABILITIES
# Classifies each session open vs prior RTH range, then shows touch rates
# for pHOD, pLOD, and pClose conditioned on opening classification.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === HOLIDAY FILTER ===
is_holiday = holiday(days_before=0, days_after=0, holiday_calendar=HolidayCalendar.CMEGlobexEquitiesHolidayCalendar)

# === RTH SESSION WINDOW ===
rth_sw = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(open_price, high, low, close)

# === BLACK FRIDAY FILTER ===
is_friday = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Friday)
is_november = month_of_year(month=Month.November)
is_4th_week = week_of_month(week=WeekOfMonth.Fourth)
bf_at_open = where(rth_sw.opened, (1.0 if (is_friday and is_november and is_4th_week) else 0.0))
is_black_friday_session = ffill(bf_at_open) > 0.5

rth_valid = (rth_sw.closed and not is_holiday and not is_black_friday_session)

# === PREVIOUS DAY LEVELS (only pClose, pHOD, pLOD needed) ===
rth_close_at_eod = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.close)
prev_close = ffill(rth_close_at_eod >> 1)

rth_high_at_eod = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.high)
prev_hod = ffill(rth_high_at_eod >> 1)

rth_low_at_eod = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.low)
prev_lod = ffill(rth_low_at_eod >> 1)

# === OVERNIGHT (ETH) SESSION WINDOW: 16:00–09:30 ET ===
on_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='16:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# Capture overnight high / low at overnight session close (= RTH open moment)
on_high_raw = where(on_sw.closed, on_sw.high)
on_low_raw = where(on_sw.closed, on_sw.low)
onh = ffill(on_high_raw)
onl = ffill(on_low_raw)
on_mid = (onh + onl) / 2.0

# === OVERNIGHT OPEN CLASSIFICATION (vs ON midpoint, ±2 pt tolerance) ===
on_tolerance = 2.0
on_opens_above = (rth_sw.open > on_mid + on_tolerance)
on_opens_below = (rth_sw.open < on_mid - on_tolerance)
on_opens_at = (rth_sw.open >= on_mid - on_tolerance and rth_sw.open <= on_mid + on_tolerance)

on_above_valid = (rth_valid and on_opens_above)
on_at_valid = (rth_valid and on_opens_at)
on_below_valid = (rth_valid and on_opens_below)

# =============================================================================
# OPENS ABOVE ON MID — Touch flags for ONH and ONL during RTH
# =============================================================================
on_above_count = where(on_above_valid, 1.0)
on_above_onh = where(on_above_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onh and rth_sw.high >= onh) else 0.0))
on_above_onl = where(on_above_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onl and rth_sw.high >= onl) else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# OPENS AT ON MID (±2 pts) — Touch flags for ONH and ONL during RTH
# =============================================================================
on_at_count = where(on_at_valid, 1.0)
on_at_onh = where(on_at_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onh and rth_sw.high >= onh) else 0.0))
on_at_onl = where(on_at_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onl and rth_sw.high >= onl) else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# OPENS BELOW ON MID — Touch flags for ONH and ONL during RTH
# =============================================================================
on_below_count = where(on_below_valid, 1.0)
on_below_onh = where(on_below_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onh and rth_sw.high >= onh) else 0.0))
on_below_onl = where(on_below_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= onl and rth_sw.high >= onl) else 0.0))

# === OPEN CLASSIFICATION ===
opens_above = (rth_sw.open > prev_hod)
opens_below = (rth_sw.open < prev_lod)
opens_within = (rth_sw.open >= prev_lod and rth_sw.open <= prev_hod)

above_valid = (rth_valid and opens_above)
within_valid = (rth_valid and opens_within)
below_valid = (rth_valid and opens_below)

# =============================================================================
# OPENS ABOVE PREVIOUS RANGE — Touch flags for pHOD, pLOD, pClose
# =============================================================================
above_count = where(above_valid, 1.0)
above_phod = where(above_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_hod and rth_sw.high >= prev_hod) else 0.0))
above_plod = where(above_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_lod and rth_sw.high >= prev_lod) else 0.0))
above_pclose = where(above_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_close and rth_sw.high >= prev_close) else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# OPENS WITHIN PREVIOUS RANGE — Touch flags for pHOD, pLOD, pClose
# =============================================================================
within_count = where(within_valid, 1.0)
within_phod = where(within_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_hod and rth_sw.high >= prev_hod) else 0.0))
within_plod = where(within_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_lod and rth_sw.high >= prev_lod) else 0.0))
within_pclose = where(within_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_close and rth_sw.high >= prev_close) else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# OPENS BELOW PREVIOUS RANGE — Touch flags for pHOD, pLOD, pClose
# =============================================================================
below_count = where(below_valid, 1.0)
below_phod = where(below_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_hod and rth_sw.high >= prev_hod) else 0.0))
below_plod = where(below_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_lod and rth_sw.high >= prev_lod) else 0.0))
below_pclose = where(below_valid, (1.0 if (rth_sw.low <= prev_close and rth_sw.high >= prev_close) else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS — Three Summary Tables
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens Above Prior RTH Range — Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'pHOD Touched', 'pLOD Touched', 'pClose Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Touch Probabilities',
    order=0
)(above_count, above_phod, above_plod, above_pclose)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens Within Prior RTH Range — Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'pHOD Touched', 'pLOD Touched', 'pClose Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Touch Probabilities',
    order=1
)(within_count, within_phod, within_plod, within_pclose)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens Below Prior RTH Range — Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'pHOD Touched', 'pLOD Touched', 'pClose Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Touch Probabilities',
    order=2
)(below_count, below_phod, below_plod, below_pclose)

# =============================================================================
# OVERNIGHT LEVEL REPORTERS — Three Summary Tables
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens Above ON Midpoint — ONH / ONL Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'ONH Touched', 'ONL Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Touch Probabilities',
    order=3
)(on_above_count, on_above_onh, on_above_onl)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens At ON Midpoint (±2 pts) — ONH / ONL Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'ONH Touched', 'ONL Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Touch Probabilities',
    order=4
)(on_at_count, on_at_onh, on_at_onl)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Opens Below ON Midpoint — ONH / ONL Touch Probabilities',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Samples', 'ONH Touched', 'ONL Touched'],
        col_headers=['Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Touch Probabilities',
    order=5
)(on_below_count, on_below_onh, on_below_onl)
